title: Robert Bigelow's plan to hire the guest fell through

tellings.quote: >> Yeah. Robert Bigalow was going to hire me for his company at one time, too, and that also fell through.

plain: Robert Bigelow, a businessman who ran his own aerospace company, Bigelow Aerospace, once planned to hire Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants. Colbern says so himself, adding that the job fell through, just as another opportunity had: "that also fell through."
